integrity: Proven by preimage ballot characterization and unique cyclic primitive-Dyck factorization. Supplementary exhaustive finite checks are not a proof for unbounded n.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic synchronous one-dimensional Rule 184 on labelled finite cycles only. Does not cover stochastic/asynchronous traffic; no joint large-size scaling limit asserted. Novelty subject to incomplete full-text availability for some adjacent sources.
title: A complete Catalan-logarithm census of relaxation layers in cyclic traffic Rule 184
